Buy a Indian Visa on Telegram

The advertised price for a Indian visa on Telegram usually sits between 5500–20000 INR. Anything far below that band is a print and anything far above it should come with a register check you can run yourself.

Document type
A visa is an entry permission issued by a consulate or, increasingly, as a PDF. It is not a document you carry on its own and it only means anything inside a passport.

buy indian visa on telegram – the short version

For a Indian visa the realistic expectation is 5500–20000 INR and one to three weeks of waiting. Same day delivery at the bottom of the band usually means a digital file rather than a card.

Read the price table before you open a chat, not after. Knowing the band stops you anchoring on whatever number the seller opens with.

Buy a Visa via Telegram: how the transaction works

The transaction runs in a private chat, usually after a public channel advert. That is fine. What matters is that the sequence is fixed before money moves: photos first, then a number check, then payment, then tracked delivery.

Some sellers will push for the full amount up front. Offer the deposit and hold firm on the balance. Most accept and the ones who do not are usually reselling stock they do not have.

Who actually issues a Visa

It helps to know that an Indian mission does not sell to the public through Telegram. The chain always ends at that office and the register it keeps is the only authority that counts.

If the seller names a different office, that is not automatically wrong. an Indian mission may delegate. But the answer should be specific enough to be checkable, and vague regional answers are not.

Replica or registered original

The middle tier is stock. The seller has real blank or cancelled stock of the right type and prints onto it, so the physical layer is genuine and the number is invented. Most adverts at the middle of the band are this.

Some sellers will not send a number before a deposit. That is a reasonable position, but the deposit should be small and the number should follow immediately after it.

What a fair price looks like

Treat 5500–20000 INR as the market for a Indian visa and every deviation as a claim to be tested. A high price is a promise of quality, so make the seller keep it.

The honest summary is that you get what the tier buys. Pay the print price for a print, the stock price for stock, and the top price only when somebody proves the number.

The buying process, step by step

Work through these in order. Each step exists because it is where a bad Indian visa deal usually breaks.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is an Indian mission.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format an Indian mission uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 5500–20000 INR band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

The five checks below take minutes and catch almost everything. Two of them are specific to India.

  • Check the licence for the RTO code and the state smart card format and confirm the licence number structure.
  • Confirm the passport emblem printing and the machine-readable zone.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for an Indian mission. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

None of these are fatal alone. All of them are fatal when the seller has no explanation.

  • A licence bearing an RTO code that does not belong to the state in the address.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a visa cost on Telegram?

Between 150 and 850 US dollars. Stickers sit higher than PDFs, and a sticker with a resolving number sits at the top.

Do I need the passport as well?

Yes. A visa alone proves nothing because it has to sit in a passport with a matching number.

Are PDF visas real documents?

They are real permissions, but as files they are trivially edited. Treat the number, not the file, as the thing to check.

What should the seller show me?

The sticker edge and the passport number field, plus the issuing post. If the post is unnamed, walk away.

Can a visa number be checked?

Against the consular system only, and usually only by the holder. Ask for the appointment receipt as corroboration.

Before you pay

Take the checks above into the chat. If a seller passes all of them, the Indian visa is worth the top of the band.
